title: Sending Money Overseas
meta: B2 · 约 270 词 · 场景：跨境汇款与到账延误

lines.en: **Hi, I'd like to send some money to my parents in China. What's the best way to do it?**
lines.zh: 你好，我想给在中国的父母汇点钱。怎么汇最好？

lines.en: We can do a ==telegraphic transfer== straight to their bank account. How much are you thinking of sending?
lines.zh: 我们可以电汇直接到他们的银行账户。您打算汇多少？

lines.en: About five thousand Singapore dollars. What's today's ==exchange rate==?
lines.zh: 大约五千新币。今天的汇率是多少？

lines.en: It's five point two eight yuan to the dollar right now, but it __moves throughout__ the day.
lines.zh: 现在是一新币兑五点二八人民币，不过一天之中会变动。

lines.en: And what are the ==charges==? Is there a fee on both sides?
lines.zh: 手续费呢？两边都要收费吗？

lines.en: Our fee is twenty dollars. Their bank, or an ==intermediary== bank, may also __take a cut__.
lines.zh: 我们收二十元。对方银行或者中转行也可能扣一部分。

lines.en: Is there a way to make sure my parents receive the full amount?
lines.zh: 有没有办法确保我父母收到全额？

lines.en: You can choose to pay all charges yourself. That's an extra fifteen dollars.
lines.zh: 您可以选择所有费用由您承担，要多付十五元。

lines.en: Let's do that. __How long__ will it take to arrive?
Normally one to three working days.
Hi, I sent a transfer to China last Monday, and it still hasn't arrived. Could you help me find out what's going on?
lines.zh: 你好，我上周一往中国汇了一笔钱，到现在还没到账。能帮我查查是怎么回事吗？

lines.en: Certainly. Do you have the transaction ==reference==?
lines.zh: 当然。您有交易参考号吗？

lines.en: Yes, it's T T, nine four seven, two eight one.
lines.zh: 有，是 TT 九四七二八一。

lines.en: Thank you. It looks like the receiving bank has put it __on hold__. The name doesn't quite ==match== their records.
lines.zh: 谢谢。看起来收款行把这笔钱暂扣了，收款人名字和他们的记录对不上。

lines.en: Oh, I might have spelled my father's name with a space in the middle. What do I need to do?
lines.zh: 哦，我可能把我父亲名字中间多打了一个空格。我需要做什么？

lines.en: Please fill in an ==amendment== form with the name exactly as it appears on his account.
lines.zh: 请填一份修改申请表，名字要和他账户上的完全一致。

lines.en: **Will there be another fee for that, and how long will it take after the correction?**
lines.zh: 改这个还要再收费吗？改完之后要多久？

lines.en: There's a ten dollar fee, I'm afraid, and it should __go through__ within two working days.
lines.zh: 恐怕要收十元，一般两个工作日内就能到账。

lines.en: Alright, I'll fill it in now. Lesson learned. Thanks for your help.
lines.zh: 好吧，我现在就填。长教训了。谢谢帮忙。

gist.q: 汇款的手续费怎么算？「你」选了哪种方式？
gist.a: 银行收二十元，中转行或对方银行可能另扣；「你」多付十五元承担全部费用，确保父母收到全额。
收款人名字和对方银行记录不一致，「你」可能在父亲名字中间多打了空格，钱被暂扣了。
填修改申请表、按账户上的名字改正，收十元，两个工作日内到账。

prompts.q: 你想每个月固定给父母汇一笔钱，到银行咨询有没有定期汇款服务、汇率怎么锁定、能否在手机上操作。
prompts.ref: Hi, I send money to my parents in China every month. Is there a way to set up a regular transfer so I don't have to come in each time? Also, can I lock in the exchange rate when I set it up, or is it the rate on the day? And can I manage all of this in the app?
prompts.ref_zh: 你好，我每个月都给在中国的父母汇钱。有没有办法设置定期汇款，不用每次都来银行？另外，设置的时候能锁定汇率吗，还是按当天汇率算？这些能都在手机应用里操作吗？

prompts.q: 父母收到的钱比你汇的少了一些。打电话问银行原因，并要求说明各项扣费。
prompts.ref: Hi, I sent a transfer to my parents last week, and I chose to pay all the charges myself. But they received about two hundred yuan less than expected. Could you tell me why? I'd like a breakdown of every fee that was taken. If it was a mistake on the bank's side, I'd like the difference refunded.
prompts.ref_zh: 你好，我上周给父母汇了一笔钱，选了所有费用由我承担。但他们收到的钱比预期少了大约两百人民币。能告诉我原因吗？我想要一份每项扣费的明细。如果是银行这边的错，希望把差额退还。

words.ex: The rent was paid by telegraphic transfer from overseas.
The exchange rate is better at the money changer in the mall.

The intermediary bank took a small fee.

The name on the ticket must match your passport.
I made a small amendment to the contract.
Our plan to move is on hold for now.
The delivery app takes a cut from every order.
